title: MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships 2026
eligibility_summary: Excellent researchers of any nationality. Must have PhD or equivalent. Mobility rule: must not have resided in host country for more than 12 months in 36 months before deadline.
funding_details: Salary, mobility allowance, travel allowance, and research costs. Up to 24 months duration.
notes: Call opened 9 April 2026. Nearly 1600 projects expected to be funded. Results announced February 2027.

title: Fulbright Norway Open Study/Research Award 2027-2028
eligibility_summary: US citizens with bachelor's degree prior to start. Residency in Norway NOT permitted in year prior to grant. Must secure Norwegian host affiliation.
funding_details: Monthly stipend covering living expenses, travel, and health insurance. Tuition at public universities is free for grantees.
notes: Grants normally begin August 2027. Applications for 2026-2027 closed October 7, 2025.

title: Fulbright Norway English Teaching Assistant Award 2027-2028
eligibility_summary: US citizens. Bachelor's degree required. Up to 3 grants available. Placement at Norwegian high schools and universities in Bergen, Trondheim, or Ås.
funding_details: Living stipend, travel, health insurance, and orientation. Mid-August 2027 to mid-June 2028.
notes: Contingent upon funding. Excellent writing skills required.

title: PhD Research Fellow in Machine Learning for Cognitive Neuroscience
eligibility_summary: Master's degree in computer science, statistics, data science or related field. Fluent English. Average grade B or better in Master's thesis.
funding_details: Salary code 1017: NOK 550,800 - 595,000 per year. 2% pension contribution deducted. Includes welfare benefits and exercise hours during workday.
notes: Starting date no later than 1 October 2026. Department of Informatics, Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences.

title: PhD Research Fellow in Meteorology
eligibility_summary: Master's degree in meteorology, physics, oceanography, or related discipline. Fluent English. Grade requirements: C or better in Bachelor's, B or better in Master's and thesis.
funding_details: Salary code 1017: NOK 550,800 - 595,000 per year. Pension scheme, welfare benefits, and family-friendly environment.
notes: Department of Geosciences. Starting date no later than 1 October 2026.

title: Up to 7 PhD Research Fellow Positions (Faculty of Arts and Humanities)
provider: Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)
eligibility_summary: Master's degree or equivalent. Requirements vary by position. Must meet admission requirements for PhD programme at NTNU.
funding_details: Salary code 1017: gross NOK 550,800 per annum depending on qualifications. 2% statutory contribution to State Pension Fund.
notes: Multiple positions across Faculty of Arts and Humanities. Must gain admission to PhD programme within 3 months of employment.

title: PhD Research Fellow in Political Science (3-4 years)
eligibility_summary: Master's degree in political science, public policy, or related field. Average grade B or better in Master's degree and thesis.
funding_details: Salary code 1017: NOK 550,800 - 615,000 per year. Pension scheme and welfare benefits.
notes: Department of Political Science, Faculty of Social Sciences. Starting date 1 January 2027 or by agreement.

title: A. Wilhelmsen Foundation Scholarship Programme (NTNU IMT)
provider: A. Wilhelmsen Foundation / NTNU Department of Marine Technology
eligibility_summary: International applicants from outside Europe admitted to the international Master's in Marine Technology (MSN1) at NTNU IMT.
funding_details: NOK 100,000 per year. Applicants must first be accepted to the programme, then submit scholarship application letter.
notes: From 2027. Five scholarships available. Cannot apply directly through foundation; application via NTNU after admission.

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters - Norway-linked programmes (2027 intake)
provider: European Commission / Multiple Norwegian universities (NTNU, NMBU, UiT)
eligibility_summary: Students from all countries. Must hold first higher education degree. Cannot have previously benefited from EMJM scholarship.
funding_details: EUR 1,400/month living allowance (max 24 months), travel contribution, visa costs, and tuition fee waiver.
notes: Norwegian-linked programmes include CYBERSURE (NTNU), AQUAH (NTNU), Manufacturing 4.0 (NTNU), and others. Applications typically open Oct-Jan.

title: MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships 2027
eligibility_summary: Researchers of any nationality with PhD. Mobility rules apply. Open to researchers wishing to undertake international mobility in Europe.
funding_details: Salary, mobility allowance, travel allowance, and research costs. 12-24 months duration.
notes: Indicative timeline: launch 7 April 2027, deadline 8 September 2027, results February 2028. Budget approx EUR 388.57 million.

title: VID Specialized University PhD Research Fellowships in Theology and Religion
eligibility_summary: Master's degree in theology or related field (religious studies, history of religion, sociology of religion, etc.). Grades B or higher in master's thesis and programme average.
funding_details: Salary code 1017: NOK 550,800 per year. State Pension Plan, accident and group life insurance. Annual salary increases.
notes: Up to 5 positions. Starting date January 2027 or by agreement. Places of employment: Oslo, Bergen, Stavanger, Tromsø.

title: Coimbra Group Scholarship Programme 2026 (University of Bergen)
eligibility_summary: Early-career researchers from Africa (select countries) or Latin America. Must be doctoral students, postdoctoral researchers, or junior researchers.
funding_details: Stipend EUR 1,800/month (up to 3 months) + travel support up to EUR 1,200 round-trip. No insurance provided.
notes: Research stays during 2026/2027 academic year. Requires invitation letter from UiB supervisor. Next call expected early 2027.

title: NORAM Graduate Scholarship (Americans to Norway)
eligibility_summary: US citizens pursuing graduate-level study or research in Norway. Must have completed bachelor's degree. Preference for first master's degree.
funding_details: Up to NOK 40,000 per academic year (August 1 - May 31). Amount depends on research subject, purpose, financial need, and length of stay.
notes: 2026-2027 applications closed April 1, 2026. Maximum of two academic years of support. Must apply through NORAM portal.

title: Anglo-Norse Society Scholarship (NTNU)
eligibility_summary: British subjects with good Honours degree or equivalent, admitted to a Master's degree at NTNU. First Class or good Upper Second Class degree required.
funding_details: GBP 3,000 for one year of postgraduate study.
notes: Scheme extended until 2026-27. Recipient chosen by NTNU based on first degree results. No separate application needed; considered automatically upon admission.

title: University of Stavanger PhD Fellowship in Social Studies
eligibility_summary: Relevant five-year master's degree or equivalent. Strong project description within social studies. Funding plan required.
funding_details: Salary according to Norwegian State salary scale for PhD research fellows (code 1017). NOK 550,800 per year.
notes: Department of Social Studies. Must apply for admission to PhD programme with funding plan.

title: PhD Research Fellow in Social Anthropology (GENMAR Project)
eligibility_summary: Master's degree in social anthropology or related field. Must contribute to GENMAR project themes. Proficiency in oral and written English.
funding_details: Salary code 1017: NOK 568,700 per year with automatic 3% annual increase. Personal funds for fieldwork, books, conference attendance. Pension fund membership.
notes: Funded by European Research Council (ERC) through GENMAR project. Starting date 1 January 2027 at the latest.

title: NMBU PhD Scholarship within Economics or Business
eligibility_summary: Master's degree in economics, business administration, entrepreneurship and innovation, or similar. Grade B or better overall and on thesis. MBA does NOT qualify.
funding_details: Salary code 1017: NOK 550,800 per year. Employment contract follows national guidelines. Possible 1-year extension with teaching duties.
notes: School of Economics and Business. Starting date 1 September 2026. Priority topics: Transport, Finance, Climate, Management, Tax Evasion, Behavioural Economics.

title: PhD Research Fellow in Natural Language Processing
eligibility_summary: Master's degree in NLP, computational linguistics, computer science, or machine learning with NLP specialization. Documented ML/deep neural network experience. Programming skills.
funding_details: Salary code 1017: NOK 550,800 - 595,000 per year. 2% pension contribution. Welfare benefits and up to 1.5 hours exercise during workday.
notes: Language Technology Group, Department of Informatics. Starting date no later than 1 October 2026.

title: A. Wilhelmsen Foundation Scholarship Programme (BI Norwegian Business School)
provider: A. Wilhelmsen Foundation / BI Norwegian Business School
eligibility_summary: International applicants (non-EU/EEA/Switzerland, non-residents of Norway) admitted to a Master of Science programme at BI Oslo or Bergen. First master's degree only.
funding_details: NOK 250,000 annually. Covers up to 2 years with academic progression requirements (GPA B+, 30 ECTS/semester).
notes: 2 scholarships available for Autumn 2027. Requires separate scholarship application letter to A. Wilhelmsen Foundation Board. Not transferable between programmes.

title: NTNU PhD Research Fellow Positions (Multiple)
provider: Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)
eligibility_summary: Relevant master's degree corresponding to 5-year Norwegian degree (120 ECTS at master's level). Grade B or better. Admission to PhD programme required.
funding_details: Salary code 1017: NOK 550,800 per annum. 2% pension contribution. Employment includes organized doctoral programme participation.
notes: Various positions available (e.g., AI-Supported Decision-Making for Asset Management). Must gain admission to PhD programme within 3 months.

title: PhD Candidate in AI-Enabled Maritime Systems for Environmental Monitoring
provider: Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)
eligibility_summary: Master's degree in engineering: mechatronics, mechanical, robotics, cybernetics, marine technology, or related. Grade B or better.
funding_details: Salary code 1017: NOK 550,800 per annum. 2% pension contribution. Part of COD-SPAWN project with real-world marine environmental monitoring.
notes: Department of Ocean Operations and Civil Engineering. Master's degree must be obtained by August 2026.
